teacherNote: Marked against: Splitting the middle term correctly to form 2x² − 6x − x + 3 = 0 (1); Factoring by grouping to obtain (2x − 1)(x − 3) = 0 (1); Equating factors to zero to find the roots (1). You split the middle term correctly and demonstrated a clear understanding of the factorisation method. Take extra care with signs when factoring negative terms: factoring −1 from −x + 3 gives −1(x − 3), which leads to the correct roots 1/2 and 3.
